text:
support_jordan: Heads-up — EU customer (acme-eu) opened a support escalation: since ~08:25 they see intermittent 403s and much higher latency. Their trace shows many requests routed to us-east-1 despite org residency=EU. Audit system fired cross-region residency alerts. Sample request IDs: req_8a2f, req_8a30. Repro steps included by customer (see below).

lina_oncall: @support_jordan can you drop a sample audit event and the request headers? Also which endpoint/model were they calling and are they on dedicated/dedicated-shared?

support_jordan: Pasting minimal audit snippet and headers from the customer: ```
AuditEvent: {
  "request_id": "req_8a2f",
  "org": "acme-eu",
  "requested_region": "eu-west-1",
  "routed_region": "us-east-1",
  "policy": "eu-residency",
  "decision": "fallback",
  "reason": "capacity_constrained",
  "ts": "2026-03-16T08:28:14Z"
}
Headers:
  x-region-preference: eu
  authorization: Bearer <redacted-token>
  x-client-id: acme-eu-01
```
Customer repro (they sent): `for i in {1..20}; do curl -H \"x-region-preference: eu\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate & done`

mike_prod: Router logs show a routing fallback at 08:27:59 due to eu-west-1 pool dropping below min replicas. Snippet: ```
[2026-03-16T08:27:59Z] router: route_decision request=req_8a2f org=acme-eu from=eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 reason=pool_unhealthy fallback_policy=allow
[2026-03-16T08:28:01Z] router: connection_established pool=us-east-1 worker_id=we-23
```
We should have denied fallback for residency-tagged orgs; looks like fallback_policy was incorrectly set to `allow` for some customers after the recent routing config rollout.

deploy-bot: autoscaler: burst event detected 2026-03-16T08:26:45Z, scale-up failed for eu-west-1 due to insufficient capacity in that region, triggered fallback routing to us-east-1. (autoscaler_event_id=ae-7723)

security_alan: This is a GDPR/ residency trigger — cross-region routing of customer data. We need an incident and immediate mitigation. Action items: collect full audit + proxy logs for req_8a2f/req_8a30, identify tokens used, and notify Legal & Compliance. Do not redact the audit chain for the incident.

billing_nina: Billing noticed a cross-region egress spike for acme-eu during 08:25-08:40 — preliminary estimate ~$450. We should consider crediting the customer if this was our routing mistake. Assigning to me to compute final impact once logs are collected.

lina_oncall: Short repro and triage checklist I ran locally: 1) Set `x-region-preference: eu` and hammer the endpoint (curl loop above). 2) Query router traces: `rg \"req_8a2f\" /var/log/router/*.log -n` 3) Check pool health: `curl http://orch-api.internal/pools/eu-west-1/health`
Also suggested immediate mitigation: flip the residency fallback flag to `deny` for org=acme-eu (hotfix) until we rollback the rollout that changed default fallback behavior.

support_jordan: Customer has paused traffic for now, but wants a clear explanation and remediation plan. I've opened INC-2026-042 and CC'd the customer-facing CSM.

security_alan: Proposed immediate steps: 1) Block fallback for org acme-eu (temporary deny) 2) Re-ingest 08:20-08:40 routing/audit logs into compliance index with full retention 3) Legal notification + draft customer notice 4) Postmortem to include the config rollout that altered fallback defaults. Who will take (1)?

mike_prod: I'll take (1). I'll push a routing policy patch to explicitly set `fallback=deny` for residency-tagged orgs and roll to canary in eu-control-plane in the next 15m. Creating PR now and will paste link.

lina_oncall: I'll run live queries and confirm after Mike's change. Example query: `select count(*) from routing_events where org='acme-eu' and routed_region!='eu-west-1' and ts > '2026-03-16T08:00:00Z'`

billing_nina: tagging @finance-team for refund calc. I'll wait for the complete log dump before finalizing credit.

support_jordan: Thanks — I'll update the customer that we have a mitigation (blocking fallback) and we're running an internal audit. Will attach logs & INC number. :thumbsup:

mike_prod: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/+/PR-4891 (patch + canary rollout). Starting canary now.

lina_oncall: Canary looks good so far, router traces show no further cross-region routes for acme-eu in the last 3 minutes. Will keep monitoring for 30m.

security_alan: Good. After we verify, schedule the compliance re-ingest and loop in Legal for customer notification text.

support_jordan: Closing loop with customer now. Will update INC-2026-042 with timeline, logs, and actions.

(End of thread)
